summary: Command context state initialization. Sets the state dispatcher code at obj+0x14 to 101 and dispatches (obj,1), then switches to state 60 with a no-arg dispatch when the re-entry flag at *(this+0x190)+0x50 is already set. Initializes three 16-byte field arrays near this+0xDA (values 1, 5 and 0 respectively), resets a set of context fields (DWORDs this+0x24 and this+0xFC to 0, bytes this+0x100/0x101/0x106/0x107/0x108 to 0, words this+0x102/0x104 to 1), sets the re-entry guard flag to 1, and returns 1.

local_names.this: command dispatch context object; this+0 holds the state dispatcher table
local_names.obj: state dispatcher table reached through this+0; +0 no-arg vfunc, +4 parameterized vfunc, +0x14 state code
local_names.v1: cursor into the 16-byte field arrays, starts at this+0xDA
local_names.v3: state dispatcher object pointer used for the parameterized dispatch

operations.description: Set the state code at obj+0x14 to 101 (primary entry state) before the first dispatch
Dispatch through the parameterized vtable entry at obj+0x4 with (this, 1)
Branch on the re-entry flag byte at *(this+0x190)+0x50; when non-zero the state is reset instead of initialized
Override the state code at obj+0x14 to 60 when the re-entry flag is already set
Dispatch through the no-arg vtable entry at obj+0x0 with (this) for the re-entry path
16 iterations writing constant bytes into three parallel field arrays: 1 into this+0xDA, 5 into this+0xEA, and 0 into the byte range 16 bytes before this+0xDA
Reset two DWORD context fields to 0: this+0x24 and this+0xFC
Reset byte context fields to 0 at this+0x100, this+0x101, this+0x106, this+0x107 and this+0x108
Set word context fields to 1 at this+0x102 and this+0x104
Set the re-entry guard flag at *(this+0x190)+0x50 to 1 so a later entry takes the state-60 path
Return 1 to the caller CommandDispatchStateMachine (0051126a) as success
